description: The text of a company's SEC filing, or one section of it: a 10-K's or 10-Q's risk factors, legal proceedings, management's discussion (MD&A), business or cybersecurity; what an 8-K announced (and its exhibits, like the EX-99.1 press release); a proxy's (DEF 14A) executive pay; an S-1. Pass a section by plain name ('risk factors', 'legal proceedings', 'MD&A') or item ('item 1a', 'item 2.02'), and/or a query to get just the passages that mention it ('going concern', 'customer concentration'). Defaults to the latest 10-K. Long sections come in pages (offset). Every result links to the document. Quote the filer's words.

company.description: Ticker, company name or SEC CIK

exhibit.description: An exhibit of the filing instead of its main document, e.g. 99.1 (an 8-K's press release)

filing.description: A specific filing: accession number or sec.gov link

nth.description: 0 = latest filing of that form (default), 1 = the one before...

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long section (nextOffset from the last call)

query.description: Words to find; returns the passages around them

name: filing_text
title: What a filing says (SEC)
